1. A project correction without an alias clears the alias.
   Shows A03-1. [witness: verification:registry_a03_correction_without_alias_clears_it]
statements:
```text
after correct(p, facts f) accepted:
  editable(p) = f   -- A03-1
  non_editable(p) = non_editable(p before)   -- A03-2
  f = editable(p before) => p = p before   -- A03-3
```
